name: NutriCalm for Dogs (50 capsule) by RX VITAMINS
description: NutriCalm Dogs 50 caps' Veterinary Formula Amount Per Capsule: Active Ingredients L-Tryptophan (free from amino acid) 150 mg Valerian Root Extract (valeriana officianlis) 50 mg Ashwaganda Extract (withania soniferum) 50 mg Catnip extract (nepeta cati) 50 mg L-Theanine (Suntheanine brand) 25 mg Calcium (aspartate) 30 mg Magnesium (aspartate) 30 mg Inactive Ingredients: Gelatin, glycerin, silica, and water. Directions for Use: One (1) capsule for every 25-50 lbs of body weight, twice daily as needed Warnings: In case of accidental overdose, contact a health professional immediately. If animal's condition worsens or does not improve, stop product administration and consult your veterinarian. Do not use in conjuction with CNS depressants. Do not use in conjunction with or prior to anesthesia. DO not use in conjuction with hepatotoxic drugs. Precautions: Safe use in pregnant animals or animals intended for breeding has not been proven. Keep out of the reach of children and other animals.
